title: Freelance Developer Launch Kit
audience: Developers building a freelance business from technical skill to repeatable pipeline.
shortDescription: Build a freelance development business from technical skill to repeatable pipeline.
coreOutcome: Connect the commercial systems required to launch and operate a focused freelance business.
problem: Offer, pricing, positioning, acquisition, sales, delivery, and growth fail when treated as isolated decisions.
situation: You can do the technical work but lack an end-to-end business operating model.
commonFailure: Optimizing one tactic while adjacent systems remain undefined creates a fragile business.
methodology: Build the business in sequence while treating each stage as part of one operating system.
capabilities: Create an operating path from delivery to referrals and recurring value
whoItsFor: Developers preparing to launch or rebuild a freelance business
whoItsNotFor: Anyone expecting guaranteed revenue or unfinalized deliverables

seo.title: Freelance Developer Launch Kit | Prospect Foundry
seo.description: An integrated system for building a freelance development business and repeatable pipeline.
